reason: I already take Toplux and reorder it when it runs out, and I have a drawer full of half-used bottles. $29.99 is more than what I pay now, so I have no reason to switch.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux ($23) or Goli ($19) and those last longer. I don't need another supplement when I already have one I reorder.
would_change_my_mind: A price at or under what I pay now, like $19 to $22 for 30 days, or a free trial box so I can see if it beats what I already take.
